items.problem: `iap-google` sets the original transaction ID only for a subscription receipt ("The original transaction ID of a subscription is the purchase token"); no defining document sets it for a product receipt (`purchases.products`), and iap.md:196 only leaves it to the adapter for subscriptions. Grant order step 4 (iap.md:129, iap.md:132) locks and binds `(store, original transaction ID)` of `iap_binding` for every product type, ownership transfer finds owner B through that binding (iap.md:175), and the value is stored in `iap_payment.original_transaction_id` that `list_payments` returns (iap.md:44, iap.md:147). Implementations can differ (the purchase token, `orderId`, or the transaction ID), which changes the stored and returned value
